information.description:
Large Two-Legged Ground Drone. Two hydraulic legs, each a ROF1 Very Heavy Melee Weapon (cyberlegs for falls). LL/IR/UV camera; alley-filling spotlights that work as a Flashbulb once an hour. Two weapon mounts, usually a Smart-Rebuilt Mk.31 HMG (50 Improved Smart), a Smart grenade launcher (2 EMP, smoke or teargas) or a Smart rocket launcher (2 Improved Smart rockets), repeats allowed.

Cost: 20,000eb
MOVE: 4
HP: 40
SP: 16
CN: 14
Counter: DV21 E/S Tech, 5 min to counter

Item Compendium (2070) • Gear & Goods

Art: Neon Hub fan art of the Cyberpunk 2077 setting (CD PROJEKT RED), free to use, not for sale.
